queue_architecture: Hardware Ring Buffer Command & Response Queues

word_0.bits_31_28: Slave ID (4 bits, e.g. 0xE for Brooklands PMIC)

word_1.bits_31_0: Payload Data Bytes 0..3 (Little Endian for writes)

word_2.bits_31_0: Payload Data Bytes 4..7 (Little Endian for writes)

word_3.bits_7_0: Control Flags (Bit 0: Valid, Bit 1: Interrupt on Complete, Bit 2: Read/Write)

0x0000.description: Controller Enable, Reset, and Master Clock Config

0x0004.description: Physical Base Address Low of Command Ring Buffer

0x0008.name: SPMI_CMD_RING_BASE_H
0x0008.description: Physical Base Address High of Command Ring Buffer

0x0014.name: SPMI_RSP_RING_BASE_L
0x0014.description: Physical Base Address Low of Response Ring Buffer

0x0018.name: SPMI_RSP_RING_BASE_H
0x0018.description: Physical Base Address High of Response Ring Buffer

0x0040.name: SPMI_IES_STATUS
0x0040.description: Interrupt Event Service Raw Status Flags

0x0044.name: SPMI_IES_MASK
0x0044.description: Interrupt Event Service Interrupt Mask Register
